meaning: An email button that sends your answer to everyone who got the first message, not just the sender.
clues: It is a choice you find when you open an email.
It is about who will receive what you write.
It answers the sender and everyone else who got the message.
Pressing it by mistake can send your private joke to the whole office.
It has two words. The first starts with R and the second is a small word meaning every one.
assumes: Cc sends a copy that everyone can see
Bcc sends a copy that others cannot see
An attachment is a file sent with an email

decoys.meaning: A line where you add people who should get a copy of an email. Everyone can see their names.
A line for people who get a copy of an email without the others seeing their names.
A file, such as a photo or document, that is sent along with an email.

exchange.speaker: floyd
exchange.text: Back in my day, a memo went to the whole list, and we called that "oops."

exchange.speaker: bud
exchange.text: Same today. Tip: before you press send, look at the To line. Does everyone on it need your answer?

blank.sentence: I pressed ___ and my answer went to everyone who got the first email, not just the sender.

why: Everyone on the email sees your answer, so check before you press it.
